concept.title: People in vulnerable circumstances
concept.shortdesc: People who are vulnerable, isolated, in crisis, homeless, seeking asylum or have complex needs, without a specific health condition named.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People described as vulnerable, at risk or hidden in their community, without a specific condition or circumstance named.
: People seeking asylum, newly granted refugee status or otherwise migrating with insecure status, and those supporting them.
: People sleeping rough, in temporary accommodation or in precarious housing, or at risk of becoming homeless.
: People who feel lonely or socially isolated and want company or connection.
: People, families or children facing an acute crisis or urgent situation who need immediate help.
: People described only as having extra, complex or varied support or access needs, without a named condition.
